subject: SignalEdge integration — contract alignment and data residency checklist
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@signaledge.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: SignalEdge Procurement <procure@signaledge.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:17:00 -0500
Subject: Proposed scope + redlines for integration contract

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the call earlier — excited to get the SignalEdge connector scoped. Attached are our initial redlines to the MSA and a short SOW diagram we discussed. High-level asks from our side:

- Clarify data residency and encryption-at-rest obligations for logs and telemetry.
- Add a 30-day cure period for non-critical SLA breaches before termination rights.
- Confirm indemnity carveouts for open-source components included in the connector.

I'm copying procurement so they can coordinate on the PO cadence. Please let us know if you want changes to the SOW deliverables (milestones + acceptance criteria) — we tried to mirror what was discussed but happy to iterate.

Attachments: SignalEdge_MSA_redlines_v3.docx, SOW-scope-diagram.png

Best,
Emily
Emily Carter
Head of Partnerships | SignalEdge
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@signaledge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed scope + redlines for integration contract

Emily — thanks for the send and the clear notes. Looping in Marcus (legal) for the MSA/DPA specifics and Vanessa (partnerships ops) for procurement/timeline. A few quick items from our side:

- Data residency: we need to confirm whether SignalEdge requires EU-only processing for customer data in scope. If so, we'll need to offer the EU deployment option in the Private plan addendum (this has cost implications).
- Cure period: 30 days is reasonable for non-critical breaches; for PII exposure incidents we need a faster escalation path (48 hours).
- Indemnity: we typically accept carveouts for open-source, but we ask for explicit attribution and a tech-control review.

Marcus/Vanessa — can you review the attached redlines and the SOW diagram and call out items that will block procurement or require exec approval? Hoping to keep this to one more legal pass.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@signaledge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed scope + redlines for integration contract

Team — I reviewed SignalEdge_MSA_redlines_v3.docx. Key legal notes:

1) Data residency / transfer: We can commit to EU-only processing for "Customer Data" if SignalEdge signs the EU Data Processing Addendum and accepts an additional monthly fee for the dedicated EU deployment. I'll draft a short addendum clause: what constitutes "Customer Data" vs "Telemetry" needs to be enumerated in the SOW.

2) Encryption and logs: We will confirm encryption-at-rest for all persisted tokens and logs. However, we will not accept obligations that require retention beyond our standard 90-day short-term logs unless procured as an extended retention service (we'll propose the data-residency-matrix.xlsx showing tradeoffs).

3) Cure period vs. security incidents: 30 days for contractual defaults is fine, but security incidents must be handled under our Incident Response SLA (48-hour notification + 14-day remediation tracking). Propose adding an exception in section 7.2.

4) Indemnity: We can accept open-source carveouts if SignalEdge confirms the components and provides a Bill of Materials in the SOW.

I'll attach proposed legal language in a tracked-redline and suggest a 1-hour call Monday to resolve remaining items.

--Marcus
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@signaledge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: SignalEdge Procurement <procure@signaledge.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposed scope + redlines for integration contract

Marcus — thanks for the quick review. A few clarifications from our side after discussing with our security and procurement teams: 

- EU-only processing: we'll accept the additional fee and sign the EU DPA addendum, but we need the clause to explicitly allow us to request a data export for audit purposes once per year. Is that feasible?
- Log retention: SignalEdge requires 12 months for connector logs for troubleshooting/regulatory reasons in our vertical (fintech). If there's an additional fee, we can budget for it — can your ops team provide an estimate?
- BOM: we'll produce the Bill of Materials for any OSS components in the connector.

Also attaching a short procurement checklist to speed PO issuance. Can we aim to finalize legal by EOD Wednesday so procurement can issue a PO by next Monday?

Attachments: data-residency-matrix.xlsx

Best,
Emily
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Quick procurement notes:

- If SignalEdge is approving the EU addendum and paying for extended retention, we can proceed under Standard Dedicated Onboarding (SKU: DED-ONB-2026). Procurement will need a signed MSA + SOW and a PO referencing the SKU.
- Please confirm expected start date for onboarding and milestone payments. For budgeting, an ops estimate for the incremental cost of 12 months log retention + EU deployment would help — tech team, please provide numbers by EOD Tuesday.

Action items for us: Marcus to provide final legal redline; Tech to estimate ops cost; Laura to confirm timeline with SignalEdge.

-Vanessa
Partnerships Operations | Redwood Inference

2) Tech/Ops: I'll have the ops estimate for EU deployment + 12-month log retention by EOD Tuesday and share the numbers to confirm SignalEdge budgets.
3) Procurement: Emily — once you confirm acceptance of the EU addendum and BOM, Vanessa will provide the SKU and PO template.
4) Timeline: target sign by Friday 20 Nov and PO by Monday 23 Nov.
